== Summary ==
Crystal Star Wars CCG trophies on a display stand at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: [[Kevin Reitzel]], from his Facebook album "Decipher Days 1996-2006".

Identification: the Facebook post has no caption. [[Bill Bisco]] identified the photo as DecipherCon 1999 on 26 October 2026.
